topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of immune inflammation.

topics.label: Innate Immune Recognition: Molecular Patterns and Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how the innate immune system senses infection and cellular damage through molecular patterns and the pattern recognition receptor pathways that transduce these signals.

topics.label: Inflammatory Response: Cellular Activation, Trafficking, and Systemic Effects
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how activated sentinel cells drive the progression and spread of the inflammatory response from local leukocyte recruitment to systemic manifestations.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how the immune system terminates inflammation, coordinates tissue repair, and manages unresolved damage through chronic inflammatory states.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture and announces the upcoming topic on the complement system.
